source_window.data_date: 2026-09-11 (Historic England listed-building polygon data update page)

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public Historic England Listed Building polygon feature for ListEntry 1495589 (Exeter Central Station), including returned Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates bound to ListEntry/Name/Grade. The official NHLE entry identifies Exeter Central Station as a Grade II railway station building first listed 24 July 2026, and the official Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer with ListEntry, Name and Grade fields; however the exact single-record GeoJSON query was not retrievable through the web channel and the distinct direct network attempt failed at DNS resolution before any feature payload was read. No geometry was inferred or fabricated.
